Let the AI use developer tools

The AI can inspect the tab it works on as a web developer would: its network requests, styles, storage and performance, and emulate other devices. Pages can try to give the AI instructions; you approve each change to cookies or storage.
Accept the risks of subscription tokens

Lets the key be a token from claude setup-token (sk-ant-oat…), which uses your Claude subscription. Compass then sends it as Claude Code does, saying it\'s Claude Code. Anthropic doesn\'t offer these tokens for other apps: they can stop working at any time, and using them this way may go against the terms of your subscription. Off, such a token is refused.
A Boost changes how a site looks or works on all your devices. You approve every Boost with JavaScript; CSS-only ones save at once, with Undo.
Compass asks an OpenAI-compatible server you choose. Add its URL and the model to ask in Settings to start.

Sync joins a chain of your devices: everything is encrypted on them, and the server can\'t read it. There\'s no account.
On a device that syncs, choose Add a device, then enter its code here.
A friend who runs a Compass sync server sent it. You get a sync chain of your own on their server; they can\'t read your data.
No server? Set up a free one on Cloudflare
Compass sets up a sync server in your own Cloudflare account. It\'s free, and only your devices, and friends you invite, can use it.

When a tab is sent to an iPhone or Android phone, Compass\'s push relay (push.compassbrowser.org) tells it at once. It gets each phone\'s notification token, never your tabs or data. Off, sent tabs arrive when the phone next syncs. You can change this later.
No Cloudflare account? You can make a free one on the sign-in page. Compass uses the access only to set up the server, and doesn\'t keep it.
1. Open API Tokens, choose Create Token, and use the template Edit Cloudflare Workers.
Only your devices and the friends you invite can sync on your server. Their data is encrypted on their devices: you can\'t read it.
Send this link to your friend. It works once, within 7 days. In Compass, they choose Sync, then I have an invite.

They stop syncing on your server within a minute. Their data stays on their devices. You can invite them again.

It stops syncing and disappears from your devices. What\'s on it stays there, and it can join again with a pairing code. Someone who has your recovery code can still join: to lock everyone out, use Reset sync on a computer.
